title: materialised timing cache + plan↔PR link table
task_body: Persist per-task timing aggregates and a plan-to-PR mapping so cvg status / dash do not have to recompute from the audit log on every render. Two new migrations, schema changes on the durability facade, an e2e test that exercises the timing cache.
rationale: Two migrations land the schema; facade + store touch the read/write path; the model gains the new fields; the e2e proves the cache keeps up; the ADR records the decision.
